title: DB errors silently swallowed via unwrap_or_default
description:
Multiple handler functions across all three servers silently swallow database errors by calling .unwrap_or_default() on query results. This returns empty vectors/defaults on connection failures, query errors, or schema mismatches -- masking operational problems from operators and returning incorrect empty results to clients.

Locations:
- smallhold/src/funkwhale_api.rs: list_tracks (L23), list_albums (L57), list_channels (L83), list_playlists (L101)
- smallhold/src/bookwyrm_api.rs: search_books (L24/28), shelf_by_status (L108), book_reviews (L182), me_posts (L390), me_collections (L407)
- smallhold/src/writefreely_api.rs: me_posts (L389), me_collections (L406)
- gaja/src/funkwhale_api.rs: list_tracks (L20), list_albums (L45), list_channels (L67), list_playlists (L82)
- gaja/src/bookwyrm_api.rs: search_books (L19), shelves_summary (L69), shelf_by_status (L84), book_reviews (L139), user_reading (L178-180), me_posts (L195), me_collections (L205)
- gaja/src/writefreely_api.rs: me_posts (L195), me_collections (L205)
- broadside/src/funkwhale_api.rs: list_tracks (L19), list_albums (L43), list_channels (L65), list_playlists (L81)
- broadside/src/bookwyrm_api.rs: search_books (L18), user_reading (L47-51)
- broadside/src/writefreely_api.rs: collection_posts (L43)

Fix: propagate errors with ? or map_err(AppError::from)? like the get_* handlers already do.
close_reason: Duplicate of fedistract-xzkb.20 (already filed). My filing had additional locations -- consider updating xzkb.20 with writefreely me_posts/me_collections locations.
